name: Delivery instructions
description: Directions for the driver, sent with the order.
source:
Component(
  dsl: 1, id: "market/delivery-instructions", name: "Delivery instructions", kind: Kind.section,
  description: "Directions for the driver, sent with the order.",
  states: [StringState(name: "instructions", default: "")],
  variants: [Variant(id: "default", label: "Default", build:
    If(condition: checkout.fulfilment == "delivery", then: TextField(state: "instructions", label: "Delivery instructions", placeholder: "Gate code, landmarks", maxLength: 200, onChanged: SetCheckout(field: "delivery_instructions", value: input.value)))
  )], data: [Data(name: "checkout", from: Client.checkout(), fetch: "client", type: ClientCheckout)],
)
